metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-73570: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted SMTP requests that may result in execution of arbitrary operating system commands as the Zimbra user.. Product: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2026-73570" or RuleName has "CVE-2026-73570" or ProcessName has "CVE-2026-73570" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-GENERAL-002
